CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, August 20, 2025 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE JULY 16, 2025 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  August 20, 2025
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, July 16, 2025
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:02 P.M. on Wednesday, July 16, 2025 at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street Alhambra,
Community Development Conference Room.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, and Commission Member Navarro.
Commission Members Absent: None.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Leonard and
Clerical Assistant II Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 16, 2025 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Commission Member Hermano and a second from Vice President Saunders,
the June 16, 2025 minutes were approved as written.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
City staff provided verified locations of Alhambra owned utility boxes to the City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission. With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from
Commission Member Navarro, Vice President Saunders and Commission Member Hermano will
meet as a Sub-Commission to discuss utility box art.

STAFF REPORT
Director Macias will present an action item at the July 28, 2025 Alhambra City Council meeting
for a donation acceptance of a 8-foot x 5.5-foot tiled mural by artist Guillermo Wagner Granizo
depicting the Alhambra in Granada, Spain from Ken Haas on behalf of his late mother Tricia
Haas. Director Macias believes the mural may be suitable for display at the new Alhambra
Community Center and has an architect currently determining which Alhambra Community
Center wall can scale it properly.

The Alhambra City Art and Cultural Events Commission approved Vi Truong’s “Looking
Inward, Reaching Outward” art exhibition for January 2026 at the Alhambra City Hall Lobby
Art Gallery.

Recreation Supervisor Leonard invited the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and their
families to attend the summer movies and concerts series in the park; the Smokin’ Cobras will
perform classic rock music on Friday July 18th and Despicable Me 4 with a science pre show on
Saturday July 19th.
 PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
No committee communication.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Commission Member Hermano, the July 16,
2025 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:23 P.M.
